mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.rpt_dev_owner), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.rpt_dev_owner), '') ) FROM ssd_field_ctg t LEFT JOIN ssd_field_ctg p ON p.ctg_id = t.parent_ctg_id AND p.ctg_type = 'front' AND t.parent_ctg_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_ctg_id != '-1' WHERE t.ctg_type = 'front' AND t.ctg_id = #{ctgId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.data_dev_owner), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.data_dev_owner), '') ) FROM ssd_field_ctg t LEFT JOIN ssd_field_ctg p ON p.ctg_id = t.parent_ctg_id AND p.ctg_type = 'front' AND t.parent_ctg_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_ctg_id != '-1' WHERE t.ctg_type = 'front' AND t.ctg_id = #{ctgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(t.biz_owner), '') FROM ssd_field_ctg t WHERE t.ctg_type = 'front' AND t.ctg_id = #{ctgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT MENU_ID FROM bi_portal.sys_menu t WHERE t.MENU_CODE = #{menuCode} LIMIT 1
